# Faculty Workshop Notes

Three speakers presented at the November workshop on AI and law:

- **Marco Delgado-Ruiz**, Wharton School economist, presented on macroeconomic models of generative AI adoption.
- **Karen Whitfield Ellison**, Yale Law School professor, presented on patent disclosure incentives.
- **Aaron Goldstein**, Chicago Law professor, presented on tax policy implications of remote work.

The workshop drew 42 faculty across the four Penn schools (Law, Wharton, SAS, Engineering).
